title: picardDirectImageDerivedTranspose_pasting
statement: Fix the shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Schemes and their morphisms are as in [def-pc-scheme]; modules are sheaves of structure-sheaf modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $f:X\to S$, $k:W\to S$, $t:T\to W$, $t\prime:T\prime\to W$, $i:T\prime\to T$ satisfy $i\gg t=t\prime$, and let $j:X\times_S T\prime\to X\times_S T$ have first projection equal to the new first projection and second projection equal to $p_{t\prime}\gg i$. Put $N_t=\operatorname{tensorPullback}(X\times_S T\to X)(L)$ for any $\mathcal O_X$-module $L$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let $D:Lp_{t\prime}^*Li^*(\mathcal O_T[0])\to Lj^*Lp_t^*(\mathcal O_T[0])$ be the derived composition square [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Let $c:N_{t\prime}\cong\operatorname{tensorPullback}(j)(N_t)$ be the conjugate of pushforward composition along the first-projection equality, and let $d:j^*N_t\cong N_{t\prime}$ be the inverse of the unique tensor-to-ordinary left-adjoint comparison followed by $c^{-1}$. Write $s_a$ for canonicalSinglePullbackMap [lem-pc-canonical-single-pullback-comparison], $u_i:i^*\mathcal O_T\to\mathcal O_{T\prime}$ for the structure-sheaf unit map, and $\alpha$ for the derived transpose [def-sc-picard-direct-image-derived-transpose]. For every derived test morphism $\xi$ [def-sc-picard-derived-model-sections], in Lean composition order, $D\gg Lj^*(\alpha_t(\xi))\gg s_j(N_t)\gg d[0]=Lp_{t\prime}^*(s_i(\mathcal O_T)\gg u_i[0])\gg\alpha_{t\prime}(\operatorname{res}_i\xi)$. This is before fibre-unit normalization and before degree-zero homology; neither $s_j(N_t)$ nor base change is assumed invertible.

proof.text: Apply picardDirectImageDerivedTranspose_factorization to each test section. Its proved one-square adjunction naturality calculation gives the pullback of the normalized section followed by the coefficient transpose.

Apply picardDerivedUnitNormalization_comp. Postcompose by the inverse derived composition comparison and the pulled-back test section; cancel the hom-inv pair. Expanding picardDerivedModelRestriction gives compatibility of the normalized test section with restriction.

Naturality of the derived square comparison moves the pulled-back normalized test section to the left of the coefficient transpose. Apply picardCoefficientTranspose_pasting to the remaining coefficient part. Combine the normalized restriction identity with functor.map_comp and reassociate to obtain the unchanged equation.

theorem picardDirectImageDerivedTranspose_pasting
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (L : X.Modules) (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S)
    {T T' : Scheme.{v}} (i : T' ⟶ T) (t : T ⟶ W) (t' : T' ⟶ W)
    (h : i ≫ t = t')
    (j : pullback f (t' ≫ k) ⟶ pullback f (t ≫ k))
    (hj₁ : j ≫ pullback.fst f (t ≫ k) = pullback.fst f (t' ≫ k))
    (hj₂ : j ≫ pullback.snd f (t ≫ k) = pullback.snd f (t' ≫ k) ≫ i)
    (ξ : picardDerivedModelSections
      ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))) t) :
    let N := (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k))).obj L
    let U := SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)
    let A := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj U
    let p := pullback.snd f (t ≫ k)
    let p' := pullback.snd f (t' ≫ k)
    let D := ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)))) p' i).hom.app A ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun q ↦ (derivedPullback q).obj A) hj₂.symm) ≫
      ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
        (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)))) j p).inv.app A
    let c := (conjugateIsoEquiv
      ((Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
        (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k)))).comp
          (Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)))
      (Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
        (pullback.fst f (t' ≫ k))))).symm
      (Modules.pushforwardComp j (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k)) ≪≫
        Modules.pushforwardCongr hj₁)
    let d := ((Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).leftAdjointUniq
      (Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j)).symm.app N ≪≫ (c.app L).symm
    D ≫ (derivedPullback j).map (picardDirectImageDerivedTranspose f L W k t ξ) ≫
        Modules.canonicalSinglePullbackMap j N ≫
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f (t' ≫ k)).toRingedSpace)) 0).map
            d.hom =
      (derivedPullback p').map
        (Modules.canonicalSinglePullbackMap i U ≫
          (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace)) 0).map
              (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit i.toRingCatSheafHom)) ≫
        picardDirectImageDerivedTranspose f L W k t'
          (picardDerivedModelRestriction _ i t t' h ξ)
